project.title: EcoImpact 2.0. Impact of wastewater on the tolerance of periphyton to micropollutants - Experiment 3
project.description: EcoImpact 2.0 focuses on the previously observed development of periphyton tolerance as MP-related biological responses in the receiving waters. The ultimate goals are to examine how to use PICT for a comparative assessment of the biological effects of treatment technologies, and whether PICT could be established as a water quality assessment tool in practice.
project.center_name: Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology
